overall: The AG found no violation: the Board's April 9 notice listing only "threatened litigation" for a Purpose 3 executive session was permissible because identifying the matter could have harmed the Board's litigating position.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 9 executive session notice was insufficient because it did not identify the threatened litigation to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board has demonstrated a reasonable basis for its claim that identifying the specific litigation matter, or even the nature of the matter, may have compromised the purpose for the executive session
